adjudication.rationale: The diff does change `findMembers` to `return;` when `name` is empty (group.js: `if (Em.isEmpty(this.get('name'))) { return ; }`), whereas it previously returned `Ember.RSVP.resolve([])`, so the return type is now inconsistent across code paths. However, within this diff, the previous promise-chaining callers (`afterModel(...).then(...)`) were removed, and the remaining shown call sites (`return group.findMembers()` in next/previous, or `model.findMembers()` in setupController) all operate on persisted groups with a name (members UI gated by `{{#if id}}`). The inconsistency is a real review concern/regression in method contract, but a concrete breakage from this diff alone isn’t directly demonstrated.
